description: Iraqi Air Force Sukhoi swept-wing fighter-bomber brought from Kirkuk and added in March 2017 to the Halabja memorial museum's collection of weapons used in the chemical attack of 16 March 1988, as reported by Rudaw on 7 March 2017 quoting museum director Sarkhel Ghafar. Spottingmode recorded it in June 2020 as a Su-20 lying dismantled on the asphalt, so it is displayed on the ground rather than mounted. An aircraft-shaped object stands beside the Halabja Martyrs Monument on Esri imagery of 9 April 2025. Rudaw calls it only a Sukhoi; the Su-20 designation comes from spottingmode alone and no serial is published.
